brief: Tech absorbed a severe rates shock without breaking. USTs sold off hard, OAT/Bund spreads blew through 130bp and stress bled into BTPs, yet the S&P barely moved while the Nasdaq and Russell closed green. NDX is nearing a major technical level, 31,200 in futures, after months of consolidation, with its 50-day average turning higher; a clean close above that level could trigger a sharp squeeze. The reason tech shrugged off the shock, per GS and MS, is that AI capex is largely rate-insensitive: GS expects hyperscaler debt issuance to surge to $420bn in 2027 while interest expense stays a small share of hyperscaler earnings; MS raised its 2027 hyperscaler capex estimate to $1.4tn against a $1-1.1tn consensus and expects further upward revisions into Q3 earnings, with hyperscaler balance sheets at 0.4x net leverage and cash at 132% of debt. The conditional thesis: if long-end yields and bond vol finally reverse lower, a tech valuation headwind becomes a tailwind, a pattern prior bond-vol reversals have produced. NDX seasonality is also due to turn supportive now.
